query_scope: One consumer call after checkpoint. Summary and three saved suffix distributions. Twenty-four rectangular/prefix conditions: unrestricted, five Pareto bounds, two interior bounds, seven infeasible-coordinate candidates, and each one-column prefix at bounds(10,13). For each nonempty family, select/rank first/middle/last (deduplicated), retain complete first-permutation prefix condition. Retain obstruction outcomes for every primary condition. Export every matching at the five Pareto thresholds.
query_work: Counts scan saved joint suffix histograms with caches. Rank/select visits saved branch distributions. Hall queries construct allowed remaining edges and subset neighborhood unions; incompatible prefixes return the exact offending edge separately. No cost-matrix or suffix-distribution construction replay.
banking: Each request before invocation, every response plus current caches and work before the next query. Entire reader output and source checkpointed; no independent exhaustive permutation census.
